Starlink is built to stay online where traditional internet fails.

The network delivers high-speed connectivity with 99.9%+ average uptime, reaching places where fiber and cellular coverage still struggle.

It’s engineered for extreme conditions too. The system can melt snow off the dish and keep operating through heavy rain, sleet and powerful winds.

Remote cabin, moving ship or disaster zone, Starlink is designed to keep the connection alive when it matters most.

Anthropic has reportedly expressed interest in building data centers in space with SpaceX.

The idea sounds futuristic, but the logic is becoming clearer. AI demand is exploding and power, cooling and land constraints on Earth are turning into real bottlenecks.

Space-based infrastructure could eventually tap into constant solar energy while reducing pressure on terrestrial grids. It’s a long-term concept, but companies are already thinking beyond Earth for next-generation compute.

The scale of AI is starting to push infrastructure into entirely new territory.

Source: siliconrepublic
